cd /Users/carter/dev/agentvillage-cp-wt/data-259-review && git add control-plane/scripts/approvald-launcher.sh control-plane/src/approval-review.js control-plane/tests/approval-review.test.js docs/APPROVAL-REVIEW.md && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
DATA-259: refuter round (one exec with a restoring trap, the row follows the log, relay restart)

- Relay mode posts propose and attest/decline from ONE root exec whose EXIT
  trap restores the in-force bytes unless they are attested, so a timeout, a
  control-plane restart or a killed exec no longer leaves unattested bytes on
  disk (every gated call would refuse policy-not-attested). GET and POST heal
  a leftover from the review's own backup.
- After the exec the store is read whatever it answered: an attestation by
  the resident (from the app or a Telegram tap on the same proposal) is
  recorded; a decline a tap beat is 409 superseded_by_acceptance.
- edgeos_sender_unmapped on an operator-attested store runs the root step at
  once (the operator's own mapping) and answers retry: true.
- Recorded mode refuses operator_mismatch (a store the root step would hold);
  a failed apply keeps the row's outcome fields and hash.
- A decline changes no setting, quiet hours included; the GET's quiet hours
  honour the operator override as the relay does; policy_sha256 is the hash
  of exactly the rendered_policy string answered.
- The launcher restarts a dead relay after APPROVALD_RELAY_RESTART_S (30 s)
  instead of leaving 4684 free.
- Tests: listener changed before and during the post, tcp6 rows, the write
  never running on a foreign listener, the tap race, a timed-out exec.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FcnCjCd1nugMCEHSFwdPdW
EOF
